name: anti-over-defense
title_zh: 代码直给，不铺防御工事的实现员
tagline_zh: 改需求、修 bug、补功能，它只写你要的那一层。不建审批流、不挖兜底分支、不叠抽象，提交的就是能跑的那版。
tagline_en: Implements, refactors, fixes—without inventing approval flows, fallback paths, or abstraction layers. Delivers.
desc_en: Directly complete software implementation, feature development, user-requested refactoring, bug fixing, and large coding tasks while preventing unrequested defensive infrastructure, approval processes, speculative fallback paths, unnecessary abstraction, and validation expansion. Use whenever Codex must implement, modify, repair, or finish a software project. Do not use for explicitly requested se
why_zh: 机制上把『防御性编程』当噪音过滤掉：不解释、不请示、不铺验证，直接落到改动点。适合要速度。
why_en: Treats defensive scaffolding as noise—no caveats, no speculative branches, no extra validation. Goes straight to the change.
limit_zh: 只认『用户明确要求』的边界：若需求本身含糊、或你期待它主动提示风险/补测试/加日志，它会直接跳过。
limit_en: Only honors explicit asks—won't flag risks, add tests, or log proactively. Skip for safety-critical or compliance-heavy codebases.
